title: Silent Shark Swimming Myth

scenes.text: Great White sharks can travel 2 miles without stopping.
People think sharks die if they stop swimming.
scenes.label: Sharks die if they stop

scenes.text: Certain shark species can rest motionless on the seabed and pump water over their gills.
scenes.label: Sharks can rest on seabed
Resting sharks
scenes.sub: Some sharks can pause and still breathe
